name: Transcend Information, Inc.
blurb: Transcend Information, Inc. is a Taiwanese manufacturer of memory and storage products, including DRAM modules, flash memory cards, USB flash drives, solid-state drives, and external hard drives. The company designs, manufactures, and markets its products under the Transcend brand, serving both consumer and industrial markets. It is recognized for its vertically integrated operations and quality control, competing with global memory brands.
